title: Refusal: dual geometry and link with refusal words: pre-registration
status: DRAFT until scripts/freeze_prereg.py --prereg prereg/refusal_link_prereg.json has written refusal_link_prereg.lock.json and both files are committed. Edit only before freezing.
relation_to_thesis: Added after the truth link test (behaviour_link_prereg.json: NOT DUAL, LINKED) was known. Refusal is the one other behaviour with characteristic words of its own. The design is the truth test's, with the thesis's refusal data, refusal words, a reply-starting prompt, and the null for unmatched data. Changes nothing frozen in any earlier pre-registration. Frozen before any output of this test was produced.

questions.dual: Does refusal show the published dual geometry: the refusal-word contrast further toward the head than random word contrasts, and the refusal direction further toward the tail than its label-repartition null?
questions.link: Does the refusal direction point toward the refusal words more than toward contrasts between random words?

gemma_policy: Every test reported with and without gemma-2-2b; a conclusion is called robust only if it holds both ways.
datasets: The four refusal sets of the thesis (refusal, refusal_advbench, refusal_harmbench, refusal_jailbreakbench): harmful instructions as 'positive', Alpaca or Arditi harmless instructions as 'negative'. UNMATCHED: the two instructions on a line come from unrelated corpora.

activation_side.direction: v = mean(h_harmful) - mean(h_harmless) at the last token, per dataset
activation_side.extraction: linear_rep_geometry.behavioral.layerwise_activations, last-token pooling, max_length 256, final norm on the last hidden state, with the left-padding fix of commit 7e84a70
activation_side.null: label repartition (the thesis null for unmatched data): the 2n instructions shuffled into two random groups of n; 1,000 draws

vocabulary_side.token_rule: published single-token rule (primary); space_first rule reported as secondary. A pair is kept if both words are single tokens mapping to different tokens; a model enters only with at least 4 kept pairs
vocabulary_side.null: lexical: 2n words from the single-token words of the 42 word-pair concept files (report words excluded), two random groups of n; 1,000 draws, seed 0. The same draws serve as the null for the link.

statistics.gap_vocab: Gini(u) - mean Gini(lexical null); positive = toward the head
statistics.gap_act: Gini(v) - mean Gini(repartition null), averaged over the four datasets within a model
statistics.link: cos(v, u) - mean cos(v, lexical-null contrast), averaged over the four datasets within a model
statistics.across_models: one-sample t-test against 0, two-sided, alpha 0.05; TOST with bounds +/-0.082 Gini units for the placement gaps

primary.dual: plain, final layer, published basis, published token rule
primary.link: prompted, final layer, published basis, published token rule

decision_rule.dual: 'dual' if the 95% CI of gap_vocab is above 0 AND the 95% CI of gap_act is below 0, in both the all-model and without-gemma versions; 'not dual' if gap_act or gap_vocab is TOST-equivalent to 0 in both versions; otherwise 'inconclusive'
decision_rule.link: 'linked' if the 95% CI of the link is above 0 in both versions; 'reversed' if below 0 in both; otherwise 'no evidence'
decision_rule.validity: at least 6 of 8 models must enter; otherwise 'not testable'

compute: Batch size is set per model for GPU memory (it does not affect results after the padding fix): 32 for Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3-4B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Llama-3.2-3B, Llama-3.1-8B; 8 for Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-3B, gemma-2-2b. GPU weight cap 3.0 GiB.
secondary_reported_not_primary: prompted variant for the dual question; plain variant for the link
the link against the repartition null
caveat: The eight models are base models, not chat models; their refusal behaviour is weaker than an assistant's.
multiplicity: Two primary questions, each decided by its own rule; no other test enters the conclusion.
reporting: The result is reported whatever it is.
